title: ACP / IDE Sidecar Compliance Gap Map v1
acp_status: partial — real transport exists, governance spine shared, but no evidence envelopes produced. Permission bypass path exists in config.
ide_sidecar_status: non_compliant — disconnected governance spine using static manifest lookup. Must share governance spine with ACP and cockpit.

acp_gaps.current: ACP produces telemetry (session lifecycle, tool call updates) but does NOT produce structured evidence envelopes. No ArtifactEnvelope creation for ACP-originated operations.
acp_gaps.required: Emit evidence envelopes for every ACP edit proposal, permission request, and tool invocation. Receipt-backed audit trail mandatory.

acp_gaps.current: bypass_tool_permissions on AgentLoop can suppress approval callback. ACP governance gating is conditional on agent profile, not hard enforcement at ACP layer.
acp_gaps.required: ACP must enforce permissions at ACP layer independently of agent profile. Permission bypass requires explicit admin authorization with audit event.

acp_compliant_areas.detail: Uses acp.run_agent() with real ACP transport.
Calls get_capability_gate() on init and at session creation. Permission approval callback integrated via build_permission_options().
ACPEditProposal flows through governance — never direct write. ACPPermissionRequest returns ACPPermissionResponse with decision.
touched_path_hashes (not paths), diff_sha256, output_sha256. content_light: true in capability profile.

ide_sidecar_gaps.current: _check_capability_permission() uses local manifest-derived permission table. Does NOT call get_capability_gate(), does NOT consult policy engine, does NOT check cockpit service state. If manifest says default_policy: allow, capability is granted unconditionally — even if cockpit is locked.
ide_sidecar_gaps.required: IDE sidecar must share same governance spine as ACP and cockpit. Permission checks route through capability gate and policy engine.

ide_sidecar_compliant_areas.detail: All capabilities loaded from canonical manifest at etc/rig.ide.capability_manifest.v1.json.
Uses defined IPC contracts. Sidecar and ACP run as independent asyncio tasks.

acp_ide_convergence_required: IDE sidecar must share governance spine with ACP — both must route through get_capability_gate()
Both surfaces must produce evidence envelopes with surface enum (acp and ide_sidecar)
IDE capability permission checks must consider cockpit service state (locked, setup_required)
ACP permission bypass must require explicit admin authorization with audit event
